purpose: Controlled late-encoder adaptation on the existing 24-photo training pool. Same publisher initialization, seed, 180-update schedule, synthetic data, loss, normalization and final-checkpoint selection as the saved decoder-only comparison. More trainable parameters and more computation per update, so not an equal-compute experiment. No held-out tuning or production integration. Native development only; no browser parity or production-release claim.

protocol.selection: Keep every production crop. Only if none exists, accept an outline-supported neural proposal with observed rectified overlap >=99% and maximum axis-normalized extrapolation <=5%, always needs_review. Use analytic projective coverage; no mask score or template selects the crop.
protocol.fits: Reuse unchanged pinned production controls. Fit every neural crop selected by the new fixed model, retaining all 32 photos, unresolved crops and failed fits. Compare with saved audited decoder-only outputs without selecting checkpoints or methods per photo.
protocol.validation: Independent exported weave error <=3%, original feature checks, geometry/paper checks, production editable conversion and independent editable-paper audit. Visual review of all photos/crops and distinct outputs.
protocol.missing: No manual rescue or result-dependent replacement. Record photo eligibility misclassifications and possible irregular weaving separately without removing them from primary denominators.
